- Supports full screen.

notes.title: About XBOX 360 controller
notes.content:
Sorry.

It does not correspond to the controller of the xbox 360. Please use such as joytokey by the PAD to OFF in setting screen.

Buttons that appear during the game is the button representation of the Nintendo 3DS.
